2607.15845.title: Knowledge-Centric Agents for Workflow Generation
2607.15845.paper_summary: Workflow generation in visual creation systems such as ComfyUI demands not only syntactic accuracy but also expert-level reasoning over modular compositions. Existing large language model (LLM) approaches often treat this as a direct text-to-JSON generation task, struggling with structural brittleness and lacking the experiential knowledge required for effective design. We argue that successful workflow generation requires modeling knowledge itself, including its structure, hierarchy, and reasoning dynamics. To this end, we propose a knowledge-centric framework that learns to invert, inject, and infer with knowledge across multiple abstraction levels. We first perform knowledge inversion to distill hierarchical representations, ranging from full pseudo-codes and skeletons to high-level strategies, from large collections of real-world workflows. We then conduct knowledge injection through supervised fine-tuning, teaching the model to reason from task descriptions to strategies and from strategies to executable structures. During inference, the model performs reversible reasoning to synthesize executable workflows, augmented by self-refinement for structural coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces workflows with richer node diversity, more coherent structures, and higher execution success rates than existing systems, establishing a new foundation for knowledge-driven, agentic workflow generation.
2607.15845.paper_summary_zh: 視覺創作系統中的工作流程生成，如 ComfyUI，不僅需要語法準確性，還需要對模組化組合進行專家級推理。現有的大型語言模型（LLM）方法通常將此視為直接的文本到 JSON 生成任務，面臨結構脆弱的問題，並缺乏有效設計所需的經驗知識。我們認為，成功的工作流程生成需要對知識本身進行建模，包括其結構、層次和推理動態。為此，我們提出了一個以知識為中心的框架，學習在多個抽象層次上反轉、注入和推斷知識。我們首先進行知識反轉，以從大量現實世界工作流程中提煉出層次表示，這些表示範圍從完整的偽代碼和框架到高層次策略。然後，我們通過監督微調進行知識注入，教導模型從任務描述推理到策略，並從策略推理到可執行結構。在推理過程中，模型執行可逆推理以合成可執行的工作流程，並通過自我精煉來增強結構的一致性。大量實驗表明，我們的方法生成的工作流程具有更豐富的節點多樣性、更一致的結構和更高的執行成功率，為知識驅動的自主工作流程生成建立了新的基礎。
